biotools.summary: The Fetal ECG Synthetic Database (FECGSYNDB) is a large dataset of simulated fetal and adult ECG signals generated using the FECGSYN simulator. It provides a resource for reproducible research in fetal ECG signal processing, particularly for training and evaluating algorithms like the Attention R2W-Net for fetal ECG signal extraction.
